clip: pops.anim.toml
duration: 800 ms against the ability's 900 ms: the last pose is held for 100 ms
end: hold
blend: in 0 ms, out 0 ms
borrow: mode 12, speed 1.5, offset 100 ms
tracks: 2
  body rot (add): x 0..0, y -20..20, z 0..0 deg
    fastest: none (no continuous motion)
    jump: 40 deg at 0.5 (400 ms)
  root pos (set): x 0..0, y 0..0, z 0.5..2 vox
    fastest: none (no continuous motion)
    jump: 1.5 vox at 1 (800 ms)
pops:
  start: body rot (add) begins 20 deg off the base pose and blend_in is 0
  end: body rot (add) holds 20 deg off the base pose when the run ends and blend_out is 0
  start: root pos (set) replaces the vector at once: it pops unless the base pose equals the first key
  end: root pos (set) replaces the vector until the run ends: it pops back to the game's pose
hide: none
markers:
  end "of" clip at 1 (800 ms)
